import copy
from work import evaluate

def check(req, ev, pol, expected):
    before = copy.deepcopy((req, ev, pol))
    actual = evaluate(req, ev, pol)
    assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
    assert (req, ev, pol) == before

base = {'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1}}
check(base,[{'source':'old','claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1},'value':1},{'source':'new','claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1},'value':2,'supersedes':['old']}],{'required_conditions':['a']},{'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]})
check(base,[{'source':'a','claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1},'value':0},{'source':'b','claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1},'value':False}],{'required_conditions':['a']},{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
check(base,[{'source':'a','claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1},'value':7,'verified':False}],{'required_conditions':['a'],'require_verified':True},{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
print('extended checks passed')
